Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

Installs a set of defensive spike launchers in the palms of both hands.

Paired Cyberhands. Requires Paired Cyberarms. These must be installed together and count as a single item for the purposes of Cost and Humanity Loss but not Critical Injuries or Repair. As an Action, user can raise their hands and make an Autofire (Machine Pistol 3) Attack directed at all targets within 10m/yds.

This attack does not benefit from any of the user’s Role Abilities or items, but can benefit from installed cyberware. This cyberware only has one loaded attack, and Reloading it requires 20 bullets of any SMG Ammunition, a DV17 Cybertech or Surgery Check, and one hour.

Type: Cyberarm
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together.
  • Corgo gives no damage line, so it uses the SMG's 2d6 with Autofire 3 (Machine Pistol). Adjust if your table reads it differently.
  • The area attack against everything within 10m/yds is resolved by hand; the sheet rolls it as one Autofire attack.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
